title: Multi-centre validation of an AI prostate MRI detection tool against radiologists
summary: A CE-marked deep-learning CAD device (Pi) trained on 793 patients was tested on a separate set of 252 patients across six sites and two manufacturers. Per-patient AUC was 0.91 versus 0.95 for MDT-supported radiologists, with AI non-inferior within a 10% margin. At its threshold AI had 95% sensitivity and 67% specificity, versus 99% and 73% for radiologists.
